instruction_bn: সংকেত অনুসরণ করে গল্পটি সম্পূর্ণ করো এবং একটি উপযুক্ত শিরোনাম ও নীতিকথা (moral) দাও। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt:
Write a story using the following outline and add a title and a moral:
A thirsty crow — found a jar with little water — could not reach the water — thought of a plan — dropped pebbles one by one — water rose up — drank and flew away.
items.model:
The Thirsty Crow

Once on a hot summer day, a crow felt very thirsty. It flew here and there in search of water but found none. At last it saw a jar in a garden. The crow flew down to the jar and found a little water at the bottom. But the water was so low that it could not reach the water with its beak. It tried again and again but failed.

The crow did not give up hope. Suddenly a clever plan came to its mind. It saw some pebbles lying nearby. The crow began to drop the pebbles into the jar one by one. As the pebbles went in, the water slowly rose up. When the water came near the mouth of the jar, the crow drank it to its heart's content and flew away happily.

Moral: Where there is a will, there is a way.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১২০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt:
Write a story using the following outline and add a title and a moral:
A shepherd boy — used to cry 'Wolf! Wolf!' for fun — villagers came running — found no wolf — one day a real wolf came — boy cried for help — nobody believed — sheep were killed.
items.model:
The Shepherd Boy and the Wolf

Once there lived a shepherd boy in a village. Every day he took his sheep to a nearby field to graze. The field was far from the village, and the boy often felt bored and lonely. One day, to have some fun, he cried out loudly, 'Wolf! Wolf!' Hearing his cry, the villagers ran to the field with sticks to save the sheep. But they found no wolf and went back angrily. The boy laughed at them. He played the same trick a few more times, and each time the villagers were fooled.

A few days later, a real wolf attacked the flock. The frightened boy cried, 'Wolf! Wolf!' with all his might. But this time the villagers thought it was another false alarm and did not come. So the wolf killed many of his sheep.

Moral: A liar is not believed even when he tells the truth.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১২০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt:
Write a story using the following outline and add a title and a moral:
An ant and a dove — ant fell into water — dove dropped a leaf — ant climbed on it and was saved — later a hunter aimed at the dove — ant bit the hunter's foot — dove flew away.
items.model:
The Ant and the Dove

Once an ant went to a river to drink water. While drinking, it suddenly slipped and fell into the water. The current began to carry it away, and the ant struggled hard to save its life. A dove was sitting on a tree by the river. Seeing the danger of the ant, the kind dove plucked a leaf and dropped it near the ant. The ant quickly climbed onto the leaf and floated to the bank. Thus its life was saved.

A few days later, a hunter came to the river to catch birds. He saw the dove and aimed his gun at it. The ant noticed this and wanted to save its friend. It crawled up and bit the hunter hard on the foot. The hunter cried out in pain, and his gun missed the aim. At once the dove flew away and saved its life.

Moral: One good turn deserves another.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১২০+ শব্দ হয়েছে
